description: Automatic enchanting for Create on 1.21.1 NeoForge - disenchant gear into liquid experience, enchant items on a belt, and mass-copy enchanted books. The 1.20.1 feature set, ported forward.

mods.name: Create: Enchantment Industry Legacy
mods.description: Automatic Enchanting, with Create. Legacy feature set, ported to 1.21.1 NeoForge.

releases.notes:
## What's new

- The 1.20.1 feature set of Create: Enchantment Industry on Minecraft 1.21.1 and NeoForge - Disenchanter, Blaze Enchanter with Enchanting Guide, Printer, Hyper-Enchanting, Ink and the Experience Rotor
- Own mod id (`create_enchantment_industry_legacy`) and own block, item and fluid ids, so this fork does not collide with the official mod's content
- Declared incompatible with the official `create_enchantment_industry` - the game refuses to start with both installed and explains why

## Bug fixes

- Opening the inventory crashed with `Itemstack already exists in the tab's list`
- Throwing a Bottle O' Hyper Enchanting crashed the client - the Disenchanter, Printer and Blaze Enchanter had no block entity renderer either
- The Printer duplicated items in creative mode whenever the copy target was replaced
- Ponder scenes showed raw lang keys, and all three machines were invisible in their own scenes
- Printer, Enchanting Guide and Experience Rotor were uncraftable - their recipes referenced item tags that do not exist on 1.21
- The JEI category and both Display Link sources showed raw lang keys
- Forge class names left in a mixin target would have crashed a Spout filling an item

## Requirements

NeoForge 21.1.180+, Create 6.0.10+, Java 21+, Minecraft 1.21.1

Cannot be installed next to the official Create: Enchantment Industry.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EmilDeuOfficial/EnchantmentIndustryLegacy/commits/v1.5.0
